summary: Now the Work enum, engine host, input_queue.I've traced the whole path. In short, the queue is held in the app layer: `aura-app` owns it, not the engine. The UI only gets a count of queued items. You can only send the oldest item early, and nothing can remove, reorder or edit a queued item. Nothing was built or run.
